name: Model AXM-50 "Blast and Smash"
description: The Model AXM-50 "Blast and Smash", or Prax "Blast and Smash" Energy Rifle, was an over-under, twin-barreled weapon designed by Prax Arms. The AXM-50 combined a Drearian Defense Conglomerate rapid-fire blaster rifle with a modified Locris Syndicates micro-grenade launcher underneath. A bipod could be attached to increase accuracy.

data.name: Model AXM-50 "Blast and Smash"
data.type: Combined blaster rifle and micro-grenade launcher
data.capacity: 250 shots per power pack; 30 in the micro-grenade magazine
